title: How fabio handles API throttling
summary: Fabio bounds known rejection retries and retries safe GET/explicit read-only POST gateway failures. Mutating Fabric POSTs never replay ambiguous 5xx/network failures; accepted/unknown submission evidence and retriable:false forbid automatic resubmission.

fabio_behavior.platform_quota: Core workspace/item APIs now document a 500 calls/min unified Platform API quota. Read list/get operations generally also have a 500 calls/min API limit, while create/update/delete operations commonly retain a 200 calls/min API limit.
fabio_behavior.lro_quota: Get Operation State and Get Operation Result each document a 500 calls/min unified Long-Running Operations quota and API-specific limit.
fabio_behavior.rate_limit_429: The generic Fabric JSON POST helper retries up to three known 429/430 rejections without acknowledgement markers. Retry-After is capped at 300 seconds; absent/invalid values use bounded 10/20/30-second fallback. Other transports differ; Gen1's strict one-submission sender does not retry even a rejection. LRO polling uses a separate 60-second delay cap.
fabio_behavior.gateway_errors_502_503_504: Safe Fabric GETs and explicitly classified read-only Fabric POSTs retain up to three gateway retries with 1/2/3-second linear backoff. Generic mutating Fabric POSTs do not retry these responses; network errors, 408 and 5xx preserve unknown-outcome evidence instead of granting replay.
fabio_behavior.capacity_throttle_430: Spark operations on small capacity may return 430 (TooManyRequestsForCapacity). fabio reports this as RATE_LIMITED error.

what_agents_should_do: Do not implement blind outer retry loops. Fabio applies the selected transport policy; no universal retry promise applies to every command.

Inspect retriable:false and error.submission before acting on a generic retry hint. An API isRetriable flag is retained as submission.serverRetriable when local mutation safety overrides it; it never grants automatic resubmission of accepted/unknown work.
Use --verbose to see HTTP response codes and retry behavior on stderr
For bulk operations, fabio uses bounded parallelism (default 8 concurrent) with automatic backoff
Treat the documented quotas as shared budgets: prefer list/bulk APIs and avoid tight manual polling loops; mutation endpoints can retain a 200 calls/min API limit even when the unified quota is 500.

relevant_flags.--verbose: Shows HTTP status codes and retry attempts on stderr
relevant_flags.--concurrency N: Control parallelism for bulk/parallel operations (lower = less throttling)

error_codes.RATE_LIMITED: The request may have exhausted retries, or the selected sender may refuse replay. Contradictory acknowledgement markers require read-only investigation, not resubmission.
error_codes.TIMEOUT: LRO polling exceeded --lro-timeout (default 120s). Operation may still be running.
